What the men say

A bubble over a man's head, in the game's paper and hand font, only while there is something to say: why he is standing, or what he has gone to do. It appears the moment the state starts, stays while it lasts, and is gone the second he is back at work. Never two lines, never a number he can read elsewhere. Red border when it is the player's problem to solve (a machine he could buy, material he could order), green when it is good news, dashed grey when it is just where he has gone.

The bubble is an SVG group in the hall's live layer, anchored 6 px over the figure's head, depth sorted with him, and it moves with him (the walker moves the group). At x10 and x30 the working bubbles are skipped (only red, green and grey), so the hall does not flicker. The one hover rule stays: hovering a man shows his full line as today.
